VIΛ with a saltire cross within a square to the left with two vertical linear grooves above

An incomplete cast lead steelyard weight of possible Roman date (AD 43-410). This weight is spheroid in form and has a slightly flattened base. There are the remains of an embedded iron suspension loop at the top. Around the periphery there are inscribed marks: VIΛ with a saltire cross within a square to the left with two vertical linear grooves above. Height: 41.8mm; diameter: 47.3mm. Weight: c.…
